title: Explore Button Zoom Only
description: Zoom a layered overview only while the pointer is over its explore control. After a level becomes active, do not zoom a control that is already under the cursor until the pointer moves and hovers it again.
summary: Pointer zoom on a layered overview starts only on the explore or open control. A fresh level ignores a control already under the cursor until the pointer moves and hovers it again.
